formulas.label: COUNTIF
formulas.explanation: Count cells in a range that match one criterion.

formulas.label: COUNTIFS
formulas.explanation: Count matching positions where every configured criterion is met.

formulas.label: SUMIF
formulas.explanation: Sum numeric values whose corresponding cells match one criterion.

formulas.label: AVERAGEIF
formulas.explanation: Average numeric values whose corresponding cells match one criterion.

formulas.label: Percent of Nonblank Values Matching One Value
formulas.explanation: Return the share of nonblank source values matching one value, with 0 for an empty population.

formulas.label: SUMIFS
formulas.explanation: Sum numeric values where every configured criterion matches the corresponding position.
